list.title: Audit log
list.intro: Every change, sign-in, approval and export, with who did it and when. Nothing here can be edited or deleted.

filters.label: Filter the audit log
filters.entityTypeHint: For example user, product or invoice.
filters.invalidRange: The end date is before the start date

list.emptyBody: Widen the dates or clear a filter.

list.denied: You do not have access to the audit log
list.deniedBody: Only the owner and the accountant read the audit log. Your attempt has been recorded.

integrity.title: Tamper check
integrity.error: The tamper check could not be loaded
integrity.denied: You do not have access to the tamper check
integrity.head: Events in the chain

explain.SUCCESS: The chain verified with no gap and no change.
explain.DRIFT: Some events are not sealed into the chain yet. This clears by itself within minutes; if it does not, call support.
explain.FAILED: The chain does not verify. Treat the log as possibly tampered with and call support.
